# HTTP API

JSON in, JSON out. The app reaches these routes through the `api` Tauri
command (`share_api` for `/api/share/*`); the headless bin serves them over
HTTP, and the dev shim serves all but `/api/share/*`. Errors carry
`{status, detail}` over IPC and `{detail}` with the HTTP status over HTTP.

**Body** and **Response** name the wire struct (see `src/types/generated.ts`)
when the handler names one directly; blank means not statically named. **Notes**
is the handler's doc comment.

| Method | Path | Body | Response | Notes |

| GET | `/api/authors?exclude_single=` |  | `AuthorsResponse` |  |
| GET | `/api/authors/{id}` |  |  |  |
| GET | `/api/authors/{id}/merge-candidates` |  | `MergeCandidates` | likely-duplicate suggestions for the merge UI, split by evidence strength: `candidates` shares this author's ORCID (near-certain duplicate), `name_candidates` only its exact full name (NOCASE — weak evidence). An author matching both surfaces once, as ORCID. |
| PATCH | `/api/authors/{id}` | `AuthorUpdateBody` |  | forwards the (all-optional) fields to `update_fields`, then returns the same detail shape as GET. |
| POST | `/api/authors/{id}/merge` | `AuthorMergeBody` | `AuthorMergeResponse` | fold `duplicate_ids` into author `{id}`, re-pointing their papers, then returns the canonical author's detail shape. |
| POST | `/api/authors/{id}/papers/{pid}` |  | `OkReceipt` | attach one paper to an author without merging whole author records. Idempotent: relinking a pair is a no-op under the unique link index. 404 if either side is absent — the FK constraint would otherwise surface as a 500. |
| DELETE | `/api/authors/{id}/papers/{pid}` |  | `OkReceipt` | detach one paper from an author. Unlinks every stored version of the paper's root: link rows are per-version and the author detail page shows latest-version ids, so an author linked only to v1 must still detach when addressed by v2's id. Idempotent on an absent link; unlinking a paper's last author is allowed (author-less papers are a legal state — `delete` requires it). |
| DELETE | `/api/authors/{id}` |  | `OkReceipt` | 404 if absent, 409 if still linked to papers; both guards live in `svc_author::delete`. |

Co-admin: management ops run on whichever admin-tier device issues them — keyhive delegation and PCS rotation happen locally and propagate through the session preamble — so this and the other member routes accept hosted AND received e2ee shares. A hosted store-only state (no node; tests) degrades to the sidecar-only legacy listing. |

## sources

Source: [`route/sources.rs`](../src-tauri/crates/server/src/route/sources.rs)

| Method | Path | Body | Response | Notes |

| POST | `/api/arxiv/search` | `ArxivSearchBody` | `ArxivSearchResponse` | `502` on any source error. `save` bulk-saves every result; `saved_source_ids` reports library membership either way. |
| POST | `/api/arxiv/fetch` | `ArxivFetchBody` | `ArxivFetchResponse` | `404` not-found / `502` other. The save is idempotent (INSERT OR IGNORE), so re-fetching a stored paper cannot conflict. |

| POST | `/api/openalex/save` | `OpenAlexSaveBody` | `OpenAlexSaveResponse` | `404`/`400`/`502` on fetch. The save is idempotent (INSERT OR IGNORE). Returns the stripped stored source_id. |
| POST | `/api/crossref/search` | `CrossrefSearchBody` | `CrossrefSearchResponse` | a `results`-only envelope. The wire body carries no `sort`, so this arm pins relevance; a transport failure is a 502 rather than an empty result list. |
| POST | `/api/doi/resolve` | `DoiResolveBody` | `DoiResolveResponse` | a bad DOI is a `400` (CoreError::BadRequest via `?`). |
| POST | `/api/doi/save` | `DoiSaveBody` | `DoiSaveResponse` | resolve then save; returns the resolved meta. With `pdf_url`, then best-effort fetches the PDF (SSRF/quota guarded) onto it. |

| POST | `/api/admin/db/import` | `DbImportBody` | `DbImportResponse` | spill the upload to a temp dir, validate it, then merge (insert-only) or replace (destructive) per `mode`. `validate_backup_source` runs before any `with_conn`, so a junk upload is a 400 with the live library untouched. |
| GET | `/api/admin/actors` |  | `ActorsList` |  |
| POST | `/api/admin/relay/members` | `MemberUpsertBody` |  | `role`/`name`/`actors` stay raw JSON so each bespoke 400 fires separately from the endpoint-id check; absent fields preserve the member's existing values. |
| DELETE | `/api/admin/relay/members/{id}` |  |  |  |
| GET | `/admin` |  |  |  |
| GET | `/api/status` |  | `StatusResponse` | one-call health/config aggregate for a headless node. |
| POST | `/api/relay-access` |  |  | iroh-relay's access check. text/plain `true`/`false`, never the JSON envelope: the relay string-matches the body. |
